text_block_list.text:
Taking a break from training, Кинг Хало
and I
make our way to the park.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'm not a fan of how the strong
winds kick up
clouds of sand.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
The sand gets everywhere, clinging to
my clothes
and hair. On top of that, it
makes me snee—
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Ugh, speak of the dust devil!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Sigh... This is why I hate sand...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
